params.name: Apply automatically to new roads
params.tooltip:
On: right after you build a roundabout, a slip lane,
a crossroads or a T-junction, its junctions get smart lanes.
Off: only the Smart Lanes road tool changes lanes.

params.name: No lights at roundabouts and ramps
params.tooltip:
On: turns off the game's automatic traffic lights at roundabouts
and where a slip lane or ramp leaves or joins a road, right
after you build them and when you use the Smart Lanes tool.
Crossroads and T-junctions keep the game's own choice.
Off: the game decides everywhere.

params.name: Free curb turn at traffic lights
params.tooltip:
When safe: at crossroads and T-junctions with traffic lights,
the turn toward the curb (right in right-hand traffic, left in
left-hand traffic) also goes in light phases where nothing
crosses its path: no green traffic into a lane nearer the curb,
no green crosswalk on the two roads it drives over. It may
merge with green traffic that enters the same lane.
Always: free in every phase, even across green traffic and
crosswalks (turning vehicles do not give way).
Both free a curb turn only where its lane turns and nothing
else: where that lane also goes straight (on roads with one or
two lanes each way), the turn waits with it, as the car in front
would block it anyway.
Set when Smart Lanes handles the junction, after you build it
or with the Smart Lanes tool; the tool's Reset locks it again.
Off: the game's phases (the turn waits with its road).

params.name: Light phases
params.tooltip:
Game default: crossroads and T-junctions with traffic lights
keep the game's own light phases.
Smart Lanes: Smart Lanes plans their phases from its lanes.
Each road gets one long green for both of its directions, with
every lane at once (turns included, as in the game's phases),
then a short phase for pedestrians only clears the junction
before the cross road gets its green. A curb turn on a lane of
its own also goes where it only merges into green traffic (as
Free curb turn When safe).
Set when Smart Lanes handles the junction, after you build it
or with the Smart Lanes tool; the tool's Reset restores the
game's phases. Free curb turn is not applied on top.
A light you switch on later gets them too, while "Apply
automatically to new roads" is On.

params.name: Automatic light timing
params.tooltip:
Junctions I choose: Keep timing adjusted runs only where you
choose Yes in the Smart Lanes tool.
All lights: every junction with traffic lights, also ones built
later. Choose No at a junction to leave it out. Lights you timed
by hand stay as they are until you choose Yes there.
Off: no junction is adjusted and no waiting cars are counted.
Your Yes choices are kept for when you switch it back on.
At most 1000 junctions. A game can also choose its own in the
Smart Lanes tool or the Crossing Tool.

params.name: Keep timing adjusted: check interval
params.tooltip:
Multiplies the time between two checks of a junction with
Keep timing adjusted (x1: 10 to 60 game minutes). Shorter
reacts sooner but changes the lights more often; longer
makes fewer changes. The counts of waiting cars (every 2 game
minutes) and their 20-minute average are not affected.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Smart Lanes writes how
long its build handling and road tool took to the game's log
file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]), plus the
road tool's hover diagnostics ([SQRL] PROBE lines). Only for
tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls
are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
